24. Thereafter the trial court delivered its second judgment dated 17.01.2007 and dismissed the suit against which the plaintiffs preferred an appeal and after contested hearing the impugned judgment of reversal was passed which is under challenge in this Revision. 

 36. Findings and decision in Revision: This Revision arose from a Judgment of reversal. So I have carefully perused all the materials on record and considered the grounds taken by the petitioners and the submission made by the learned Advocates for both sides.
